en_title: Avengers: Doomsday Star Robert Downey Jr. Hid a Secret Message on His Jacket During Marvel's Comic Con Panel — And Now Its Latverian Runes Have Been Translated
cn_title: 《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》RDJ密语被译出
subtitle: 拉脱维利亚符文藏了什么

paragraphs.en: An eagle-eyed Marvel fan has translated the secret message written in Latverian runes seen on the jacket of Avengers: Doomsday star Robert Downey Jr. during this weekend's Comic Con panel.
paragraphs.cn: 一位眼尖的漫威粉丝已破译《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》主演小罗伯特·唐尼本周末在动漫展发布会上所穿外套上的拉脱维利亚符文密语。

paragraphs.en: While the panel featured plenty of Avengers chatter — and confirmation that Ryan Reynolds' Deadpool will appear in the movie — Marvel's big Comic Con showing also held a secret hidden in plain view: a string of runes that covered Downey Jr.'s clothing, left for fans to decipher.
paragraphs.cn: 这场发布会谈了不少《复仇者联盟》——并确认瑞恩·雷诺兹饰演的死侍会出现在电影中——但漫威的动漫展大型亮相还藏着一个明摆着的秘密：唐尼服装上布满一串等待粉丝解读的符文。

paragraphs.en: Brilliantly, these runes also featured on the Latverian coffee bags previously given out to fans at another recent convention , SXSW London, and it's from these bags that Popverse 's Grant DeArmitt was able to begin working out the language to discover what exactly the new runes were saying.
paragraphs.cn: 巧妙的是，这些符文也曾出现在近期另一场活动——伦敦西南偏南（SXSW London）——向粉丝发放的拉脱维利亚咖啡袋上。Popverse的Grant DeArmitt正是从这些咖啡袋入手，开始破解这门语言，并弄清新符文究竟写了什么。

paragraphs.en: A coffee shop pop-up for ‘AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY’ has been spotted in London.
paragraphs.cn: 有人在伦敦发现了《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》的咖啡店快闪活动。

paragraphs.en: At first, the process seemed easy — as the runes directly replace English letters 1-for-1. But the language also appears to spell some words differently (the runes for "coffee" spell the word "kavi", for example, requiring some logic to work around a more phonetic alternate spelling).
paragraphs.cn: 起初，破解过程似乎很简单——符文会一一对应替换英文字母。但这门语言似乎也会以不同方式拼写部分单词（例如「coffee」对应的符文拼作「kavi」），需要通过一些推理来处理这种更接近读音的替代拼法。

paragraphs.en: This can be seen in one section of the runes, which can be translated to "THERE IS NO PROMISE OF TOMORRO", with the missing letter of "tomorrow" just apparently how it is written in Latverian.
paragraphs.cn: 其中一段符文可译为「没有明天的承诺」，英文「tomorrow」少写的那个字母显然就是拉脱维利亚语的书写方式。

paragraphs.en: Other runes elsewhere on the jacket spell out the words "JUSTICE" and "REVENGE", while more spell out "TO THE VICTOR" (a fun nod to Doom's name) and "GO THE SPOILS."
paragraphs.cn: 外套其他位置的符文拼出了「正义」和「复仇」，还有「胜者」与「获得战利品」（对毁灭博士名字的一处有趣呼应）。

paragraphs.en: One runic message still needs deciphering, as Downey Jr.'s jacket only showed a glimpse of it. Still, though, most of what was written has now been unearthed, and it's a series of typically Doom-like proclamations that the Avengers would do well to take heed of. Here's hoping he's wearing the jacket when he pops up in Doomsday, and the Avengers are quick to translate what it says.
paragraphs.cn: 仍有一则符文信息需要破译，因为唐尼的外套只露出它的一小部分。不过，大多数文字如今已经被解开，内容是一连串典型的毁灭博士式宣言，复仇者们最好认真留意。希望他在《毁灭之日》中登场时也会穿着这件外套，而复仇者们能尽快译出上面的内容。

paragraphs.en: Avengers: Doomsday hits theaters December 18, 2026. Here's the official synopsis:
paragraphs.cn: 《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》将于2026年12月18日上映。以下是官方剧情简介：

paragraphs.en: "Universes collide and the Multiverse Saga begins its final chapter in Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday," the movie's newly-revealed description reads . "Beloved heroes from three distinct universes will be set on a deadly collision course and ultimately face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered. This epic film will lay the foundation for the future of the Marvel Cinematic Universe."
paragraphs.cn: 影片新公布的简介写道：「宇宙发生碰撞，多元宇宙传奇将在漫威影业的《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》中开启最终篇章。来自三个不同宇宙、备受喜爱的英雄将踏上致命的碰撞之路，最终面对前所未有的存在性威胁。这部史诗电影将为漫威电影宇宙的未来奠定基础。」

paragraphs.en: Last week, Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige revealed that he had mapped out the company's movie plans up to 2042 , hinting at a "streamlined, simplified" universe post-Avengers: Secret Wars, a big push for the new X-Men, and plans to eventually unveil a live-action Miles Morales.
paragraphs.cn: 上周，漫威影业掌门人凯文·费奇透露，他已规划好公司截至2042年的电影计划，并暗示《复仇者联盟：秘密战争》之后将出现一个「更精简、更简化」的宇宙、会大力推进新版《X战警》，且最终计划推出真人版迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯。

paragraphs.en: For all the news and announcements from Hall H, catch up with everything announced at Marvel Studios; Comic Con 2026 panel right here.
paragraphs.cn: H厅的所有新闻和公告，可在此查看漫威影业2026年动漫展发布会公布内容的完整汇总。

summary: 小罗伯特·唐尼在漫威动漫展上所穿外套的拉脱维利亚符文已被粉丝破译，内容包括「正义」「复仇」及「胜者获得战利品」等毁灭博士式宣言。《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》将于2026年12月18日上映。
opus_summary: 唐尼外套上的拉脱维利亚符文不是装饰：粉丝借咖啡袋上的同款文字完成破译，读出了正义、复仇与胜者战利品等充满毁灭博士气息的宣言。
